title: Acodafe
description: acodafe.com Acodafe S.L. is a Spanish IT services company founded in 2009 in Mataró, Barcelona, providing managed IT, network installation, cybersecurity, cloud backups, data center hosting and GDPR consulting for small and medium businesses. Led by sole administrator Adrián Conde Kuller, it has just 4 employees and annual revenue between 500,000 and 1.5 million euro. The company grew sales by 22.8 percent in 2024 and climbed over 12,000 positions in Spain's national business ranking. Its services cover the full IT lifecycle for SMEs and industrial clients from system maintenance and installation to 24/7 emergency support. In 2019 it expanded into data protection consulting, a growing regulatory niche in Spain. Key strengths are 17 years of market presence, a lean and profitable operation and a diversified service portfolio tailored to small business needs.
